final_parent_clarifications.format_policy: Use only the selected top two legal categories. EC-F11 is explicitly corrected from the earlier reviewer interpretation.
final_parent_clarifications.need_precedence: Choose the highest applicable N before all other factors.
final_parent_clarifications.reserve_preference: While any currently useful conventional candidate remains, defer reserve-only unusual manifests from AI preference comparison before top-two format selection. Preserve all legal scores and human legality.
final_parent_clarifications.partial_load: Count each physical quantity once, as actual delivered portions at actual timestamps or only the still-undelivered committed remainder at planned timestamps.
final_parent_clarifications.staged_setback_R: Use the greater of the two confirmed projected arrival loads. The single setback starts only when actual unusual cargo completes.
final_parent_clarifications.time_windows: Handling uses (arrival minus 30 days, arrival]. Recent global delivery uses (now minus 120 days, now]. Achievement proof includes the deadline and expires strictly after it.
final_parent_clarifications.rare_access: One drawn family must fit a whole set at 1.5 B before selection, with three frozen format manifests. At most four whole sets plus one quarter of one set, reduced to exact integer template proportions.
final_parent_clarifications.allowance_and_physical_material: Format allowance, unusual strategic budget charge, and actual physical material value are distinct. Rare caps can leave budget unused.
final_parent_clarifications.native_limits: This evidence verifies declared arithmetic. It does not verify engine random sampling, native AI behavior, runtime stock grants, hooks, or cumulative MTTH probability.

final_parent_verification.method: Independent Python Fraction recalculation of the supplied audit fixture after parent policy clarifications, plus source hash binding to final core files.
